events.title: Pumpkin Patch
events.description:
October is pumpkin month at Queens Farm!
Enjoy the crisp fall air as you wander through the patch to scoop up the perfect pumpkin. Stroll through the 47-acre grounds and soak in some New York history – Queens Farm is one of the longest continuously farmed sites in New York State, dating back to 1697.

events.title: Flavors of the World Festival
events.description: Savor authentic foods from across the globe, enjoy vibrant live performances, and celebrate the rich cultural tapestry of NYC’s most diverse borough within the beautiful backdrop of our historic farm.

events.title: Bug Buddies: Household Bugs
events.description:
Calling all curious kids!

Join our 2026 Bug Buddies classes to meet the six-legged (and more!) neighbors who share our world. We’ll hunt for hidden habitats, learn about bug superpowers, and demystify the most misunderstood group of friends! Get ready for a hands-on adventure that will change how you see the world’s tiny superheroes.

Join our 2026 Colonial Cooking series to meet the ingredients, recipes, and techniques that built early America.
